title: Chicken Smash Patties
description: Lean ground chicken balls smashed thin in a hot skillet for crispy edges, served with crispy roasted potatoes and garlic-lemon aioli.

steps.title: Form
steps.text: Form 6 loose balls. Do not pack them tightly, or the patties will turn dense.

steps.title: Heat pan
steps.text: Heat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat with {oil}.

steps.title: Smash
steps.text: Place the chicken balls in the pan and smash each one flat with a spatula to 1/4 to 1/3 inch thick.

steps.title: Cook first side
steps.text: Cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the edges are crisp.

steps.title: Flip
steps.text: Flip and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes until cooked through.

steps.title: Plate
steps.text: Serve with crispy roasted potatoes on one side and the patties stacked or fanned, with a drizzle of lemon oil or parsley for color.

notes: Optional for the plates: cheese on Cindy's patties, spicy mayo, cayenne or chili crisp on yours. Serve with Crispy Roasted Potatoes and Garlic-Lemon Aioli. Timeline for a 5:40 PM dinner: 5:10 mix, 5:20 cook, 5:30 flip, 5:40 plate.
